title: neoporteria residua
intro: Neoporteria residua, commonly known as the Residua spiny plant, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the cactus family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may help in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Neoporteria residua are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and anticancer activities. However, further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Neoporteria residua on human health, and it should not be used as a substitute for medical treatment without consulting a healthcare professional.
